title: Marketing Your Grooming Business with Social Media - Love Groomers

facts.fact: According to Pet Business Magazine (a third-party source cited by the page), 60% of pet owners discover new pet care services through social media.
facts.quote: According to _Pet Business Magazine_, 60% of pet owners discover new pet care services through social media.

facts.fact: A sample caption on the page, with no cited source, claims that regular brushing can reduce shedding by up to 50%.
facts.quote: Did you know regular brushing can reduce shedding by up to 50%?

facts.fact: The page's example promotion template uses a 'Winter Coat Care Package' priced at $49.99 as illustrative copy, not a stated Love Groomers price.
